workflow.name: Slack to Jira Automation
workflow.description: Transforms Slack messages into contextually enriched Jira tickets using Claude Sonnet 4

triggers.description: Triggered when bot is mentioned in Slack

blocks.name: Slack Message Trigger
blocks.description: Validates and extracts Slack event payload

blocks.name: Extract Message Details
blocks.description: Extracts user ID, message text, and timestamp from Slack event

blocks.name: Sanitize Message Text
blocks.description: Removes bot mentions and formats the message

blocks.name: LLM Task Analysis
blocks.description: Analyzes the sanitized message using Claude Sonnet 4
blocks.system_prompt:
You are a technical task analyzer specializing in software development. Extract structured task details from user messages.

Output format (plain text, one per line):
TITLE: [concise title, max 80 chars]
DESCRIPTION: [detailed analysis with context]
MODULES: [comma-separated: frontend, backend, database, devops, etc]
ASSIGNEE: [email or team name]
COMPLEXITY: [1-5 scale, 1=trivial, 5=very complex]
PRIORITY: [Low|Medium|High|Critical]
HOURS: [estimated hours as integer]
LABELS: [comma-separated tags]

Defaults if uncertain:
- COMPLEXITY: 3
- PRIORITY: Medium
- HOURS: 4
- ASSIGNEE: unassigned

blocks.name: Parse LLM Output
blocks.description: Extracts structured fields from LLM response

blocks.name: Format Timestamp
blocks.description: Converts Unix timestamp to readable format
